lines.li: [us] Where are you walking to?
[them] The shrine at the spring, and then the one after that.
[us] And when you reach the last one?
[them] There is no last one, which is rather the point.
[them] We ask for shelter at every door we pass.
[us] And if the door stays shut?
[them] Then we bless it anyway and sleep under a hedge.
[them,likesus] Yours opened, though, and the fellowship remembers.
[us] What is it like at {TOWN}?
[them] A shrine, a hostel and too few beds, and somebody always singing.
[us] Who keeps it?
[them] The hosteller, who has never once turned a pilgrim away.
[us] What do you keep at {TOWN}?
[them] Letters, ledgers, maps and histories, everything anyone wrote down.
[us] Why all of it?
[them] Because nobody knows yet which of it will matter.
[them] May I ask you something for the archive?
[us] That depends on the question.
[them] What does your colony remember that nobody wrote down?
[us] More than you would think.
[them] You read, don't you? It shows in how you look at a page.
[us] When I get the time.
[them] Come to the archive, and you will never have enough of it again.
[us] That sounds like a warning.
[them] Everything has a price, you know, even this conversation.
[us] And what does it cost?
[them,likesus] For you, nothing, your account is in good standing.
[them,!likesus] We will put it on your account.
[us] Have you been up there, to the ships?
[them] Most of us were born nearer the ships than the ground.
[us] What's it like?
[them] Cold, quiet and very expensive.
[us] What is {TOWN} like?
[them] A landing pad, a market round it, and a lot of people in a hurry.
[us] Do the ships come down there?
[them] Their landers do, when the price is right.
[us] Was the river good to you this week?
[them,summer] Fat fish and low water, so yes.
[them,winter] We cut holes in the ice for what we get.
[them] The river gives what it gives, and we take no more.
[us] Wise.
[them] Hungry, mostly, but wise too.
[them] If your people ever need to cross the river, ask for our ferry.
[us] What does it cost?
[them] Depends on the weather, and on how much you complain.
[us] I'll keep quiet, then.
[us] What is it like at {TOWN}?
[them] Boats on the bank, fish on the racks and smoke from the smokehouse.
[us] It sounds busy.
[them] Only when the fish run, and then everyone is busy.
